source: Claude (Opus) scriptwriter, original idea; hook rotation #7, format rotation #3
title_working: The Town Where Broken Promises Crack The Street
world_rule: Every broken promise cracks the street under your feet

lines.text: Before you make a promise in this town, look at the ground.
lines.say: (serious) Before you make a promise in this town, look at the ground.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: This is the town where every broken promise cracks the street.
lines.say: (confident) This is the town where every broken promise cracks the street.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Rex breaks promises all day. His whole street looks like a puzzle.
lines.say: (happy) Rex breaks promises all day. His whole street looks like a puzzle.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Eli has never broken one. Not a single crack.
lines.say: (confident) Eli has never broken one. Not a single crack.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Then he promised his little sister Mia he would see her sing at six.
lines.say: (soft tone) Then he promised his little sister Mia he would see her sing at six.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: At five, Rex begged him to stay for one more game.
lines.say: (nervous) At five, Rex begged him to stay for one more game.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Eli stayed. At six, the street split open between him and the school. Too wide to jump.
lines.say: (worried) Eli stayed. At six, the street split open between him and the school. Too wide to jump.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So he ran the long way, through the forest.
lines.say: (serious) So he ran the long way, through the forest.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: He burst in on the very last note. Mia saw him and smiled.
lines.say: (happy) He burst in on the very last note. Mia saw him and smiled.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: Back in town, the crack closed. A late promise still counts.
lines.say: (confident) Back in town, the crack closed. A late promise still counts.
lines.speaker: narrator

lines.text: So before you make a promise in this town, keep it. Even late.
lines.say: (serious) So before you make a promise in this town, keep it. Even late.
lines.speaker: narrator
